scope: Theorem 9.1 (Exponential thresholds and force) of the manuscript “Renewal and changes of law for critical honeycomb walks” (preprints/Renewal-and-changes-of-law-for-critical-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d179fa55e4b82fed), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 59. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Uniformly over unit vectors e, as t ↓ 0, me(t) = t3/4+o(1) , mrad(t) = t3/4+o(1) . More precisely, for every ε > 0 and all sufficiently small t, t3/4+ε ≤ mrad(t) ≤ me(t) ≤ Ct3/4 , where C is independent of e. For each unit vector e and s ≥ 0, the limit fe(s) = lim j→∞ 1 j log ∑︂ ℓ(γ)=j ρj ese·(γj−o) exists. It satisfies fe(0) = 0 and fe(s) = s4/3+o(1) (s ↓ 0), uniformly in e.
